plan.title: recurrence(#4882): Approach1 mint-gate exit leaves product PR merge-path unarmed

narratives.Description: recurrence(#4882): Approach1 mint-gate exit leaves product PR merge-path unarmed
narratives.Overview:
- Product pre-CLEAN live-wait continuity through mint (relieves: P1): keep the existing product child pr:watch live across attended mint, or on Approach 1 exit immediately re-arm product with a successor whose first act is product pr:watch --monitor-agent-id after review-monitor:register (force only when prior owner is dead). A mint-PR-only waiter is not product arm.
- CLEAN-before-mint phase-correct closer continuity (relieves: P1): when product reaches CLEAN while attended mint remains pending, the post-CLEAN closer (pr:wait-mergeable-and-merge / parent-retained closer) is the continuing product merge-path owner. Do not restart pre-CLEAN pr:watch as if that were post-CLEAN arm. If that closer returns mint-BLOCKED, timeout, or error for the pending mint gate, apply the same non-option-C + same-turn re-arm rules; keep a still-running phase-correct wait or successor through mint merge then resume closer/merge path. Required focused regression covers CLEAN-before-mint and closer-mint-BLOCKED; do not treat a fixture-supplied livePhaseCorrectWait:true as proof.
- Mint-gate BLOCKED is non-option-C for product PR (relieves: P1): attended mint / intent-constraint / approved-scope / scope-provenance BLOCKED on a merge-path-owned product PR MUST NOT writeMergePathExplicitFinishAttestation / --explicit-finish for that product PR, including when the exit comes from the post-CLEAN closer. True option-C (human abandon / hard decision) stays under a different attested reason.
- Same-turn product remediates before mint attention (relieves: P2): on Approach 1 or closer mint-gate exit for a merge-path-owned product PR, same turn MUST verify:review-monitor --merge-path-arm --live-wait (and verify:cohort-review-monitors when N>1) and remediate unarmed before parent attention moves to the mint PR.
- Enforce exit/BLOCKED inventory plus mint-lane triggers (relieves: P3): keep existing #5318 call-sites after Approach 1 exit / lease release / BLOCKED halt; add mint-PR-open and mint-PR-merge as triggers that re-run cohort inventory / product --merge-path-arm --live-wait and remediate unarmed product PRs. Do not claim exit/BLOCKED triggers were absent from tip.
- Call-site probe over fourth arm reason (relieves: P4): bind the existing evaluateMergePathArm / cohort unarmed class at the mint-exit transition (Approach 1 and closer); optional eval asserts that call-site. Do not invent a fourth MergePathArmReason unless a later mint-pause attestation is separately Bound.
- Split wait / mint lane / post-mint residual: (1) product Approach 1 / closer wait continuity through the mint window including CLEAN-before-mint; (2) parallel mint-PR Approach 1 lane (one owner per PR); (3) after mint merge, dest residual rebase onto origin/<deliveryBranch> + @greptileai via existing residual/fix-batch paths, then re-enter the phase-correct product wait/closer. Successor wait is not residual implement.
- Single-owner handoff: capable parent/durable owner assigns the next spawn; reuse pre-spawn lease/active-agent check; force registration only for dead-owner recovery; checked arming after the successor wait starts in the intended worktree/root. Duplicate mint-BLOCKED notifications reuse the same product owner. Preserve dual-stop budgets across successor replacements.
- Successor envelope carries identity: repository, product PR/worktree, delivery branch, named mint dependency, and authorized action scope; resolve mint merge state from the forge and re-check the gate after fetch before mutation. Attended mint creation stays human TTY.
